text.p: A group led by Laifer Capital Management Inc has urged TRM Copy Centers Corp to consider a recapitalization of the company, which the group said could generate greater value for all of the company's shareholders.

"A leveraged recapitalization of the company, together with an involvement by us in TRM's oversight, would create a substantial increase in shareholder value and strengthen the company," Laifer Capital President Lance Laifer said in an August 15 letter to TRM's board.
Laifer disclosed the letter in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission released Monday.

The recapitalization proposal calls for the issuance of shares by the company to an equity investor for cash, the incurrence of additional indebtedness by the company in bank loans and/or senior subordinated notes, and the use of proceeds of the debt and equity issuances to repurchase a substantial portion of TRM's common stock in an issuer tender offer at $11 to $11.50 per share.
Laifer said if the board does not agree that a recapitalization makes most sense for the company and its shareholders, he is prepared to discuss a more conventional acquisition transaction.
The conventional transaction could be a cash merger in which all the shareholders would receive the same consideration as would be paid under the recapitalization proposal, he said.
The group holds an 11.4 percent stake in TRM or 785,650 common shares.
